tools.name: get_current_time
tools.description: Get the current time in a time zone. Returns the current date, time, day of week and DST status for the given IANA time zone. Returns: Current time details for the requested zone..

tools.name: list_time_zones
tools.description: List all available IANA time zones. Returns the full list of IANA time zone names accepted by get_current_time. Returns: Array of IANA time zone names..
